title: Chapter 1009
paragraphs: Chapter 1009
Episode 246. The Battle for the Mitra Desert (19)
"No, wait! We have to hold on for now, Yona."
Owl raised his hand to stop Yona.
"Huh?"
"It seems Shimat is truly enraged. The Red Energy Waves spreading around Jin are very intense."
True to his words, the energy waves near Jin and the Battle King’s were rapidly intensifying.
As a result, red whirlwinds were spreading across various parts of the desert, distorting the space.
As soon as Shimat exited the bridge, he opened his Red Divine/Heavenly Sword.
The sword that injured Teto and Garmund. Yona belatedly recognized its massive aura and shrugged her shoulders.
"So, when do we move?"
Owl didn't answer but observed the battle for a while.
It was difficult to see the details from a distance, but reading the flow of clashing energies wasn't hard.
'...Indeed, there are two more energies similar to the Battle King’s of the Plutonian. It seems more Battle King’s have been summoned, just like when Belize and Linpa appeared.'
The energies of Jin and the Battle King’s were visibly complementing each other.
These vast brainwaves may seem chaotic at a glance, but they clearly kept converging around Jin. Their connection never wavered for a moment.
At least someone at Owl's level could recognize the inherent order within this chaos.
On the other hand, the energy emitted by Shimat and his fleet was clearly organized.
The red whirlwinds were all evenly spaced like cogwheels, and the wavelengths filling the gaps all pulsed uniformly.
It even felt like observing a grand, meticulously crafted architecture.
Freedom and control. The energy waves of the Blue Plutonian and Red Plutonian had very different characteristics.
'The Red Plutonian clan undoubtedly has superior strength. But if the order of their red energy waves begins to break, can they recover just as quickly?'
The moment Owl thought this, a red whirlwind on the left side of the battlefield dispersed after being struck by a thunderbolt.
The lightning bolt came from a direction even Owl couldn't perceive.
It wasn't from the golden orbs, but from the blue energy waves moving in between.
'The scattered red energy waves are recovering instantly. But if Jin and the Blue Plutonian keep causing disturbances within the red energy waves, gaps will begin to form little by little.'
Despite this, Owl was confident that if they continued fighting, Shimat would eventually win.
Even if the Red Plutonian occasionally hesitated in maintaining the order of their red energy waves, Jin and his side would be the first to tire if the battle dragged on.
The difference in firepower was just too great.
However, the objective of the Vamel Alliance was not victory in battle. Thus, there was no reason to fight until a clear winner emerged.
What the Alliance needed was just one chance to throw the liberation device into the Lafrarosa passage.
Certainly, Jin and the Battle King’s could create such an opportunity whenever they wanted.
"Yona, just wait a bit longer. A better moment will come. It might be as short as an hour, or at most, not more than two hours."
Moreover, it's not only Jin and the Battle King’s confronting the Red Plutonian.
"Ah, it seems two more Battle King’s have been summoned. It looks like they're friends named Garmund and Teto?"
"First Flagbearer, Rital's firepower is being concentrated towards Jin. Let's find an opening."
"Alright, Dante! Maybe because you're close with the youngest, we seem to sync well."
Luna and Dante.
"Anyway, our son-in-law is lucky. Even though he hasn’t thrown the device yet, more Battle King’s have appeared? Not just for distraction, but it looks like they are genuinely ready to strike."
"Ice Castle Master, your sword truly exudes an aesthetic. Our disciple has a lot to learn from you."
"I've never met anyone who says they can teach Luna something. Especially with Vanessa right in front of you. Such an inspiration."

"The First Rider has personally chosen Lord Eltiot as a mentor, and the master has approved. After meeting Lord Eltiot, it feels like the First Rider's swordsmanship has started to shine even more. Isn't that right, stray cat?"
"Meow, nya."
"Oh, so cute."
"Uh... It's a bit ambiguous, but it's not completely without a cute vibe. It's barely enough to consider as a pet."
"I’d rather not, meow."
"Hehe, it truly is the end times. Everyone’s gone mad."
Talaris and Eltiot, and even Hedo (who has now come to accept the teasing by the Black Knights as a 'stray cat') were fully engaged, intensely charging through the enemies.
Runcandel’s decisive move, Hairan's secret technique, Ice Castle's Five Techniques, and Hedo's incredible strength combined and shook the desert violently.
While they didn’t synergize as perfectly as Jin and the Battle King’s, they displayed a collaboration that was almost as if they had trained together.
There were unavoidable openings in their collaboration.
However, Eltiot compensated for these using his unique smooth aura, living up to his title 'Blue Wind.'

'If Chiron is the method of chaos and Ron the method of order, then what this human has achieved and grasped in Genesis must be harmony. Even in this weakened state, he comfortably encompasses us all.'
Talaris and the comrades admired Eltiot’s movements.
Every time he made a move, a previously non-existent space appeared. Every step he took, paths closed and opened.
"Dash, dodge! Hacha! Go team!"

The endless shouts during combat might sound overwhelming, and the bizarre way in which one moves about the battlefield like some sort of invertebrate might not be particularly elegant. However, the essence of Genesis was something eternal and unyielding.
The defenses of the Red Plutonian's stronghold were shaking at an increasing rate.
But it did not seem to affect the morale of the enemy forces.
They firmly believed that no matter how strong the alliance was, or even if more Battle King’s were added, their aerial fortress would not be overpowered.
"Whew!"
The brightly shining Tetalon barely grazed Belize's forehead.
Garmund's greatsword pushed in as Belize momentarily retreated, followed by attacks from Teto and Linpa.
Teto and Linpa's strikes were blocked by a barrier created by the Red energy waves, and Garmond was shot down to the ground by a cannon.
A precisely aimed lightning-fast thrust at Shimat's throat was deflected by Tetalon.
Even in the midst of chaotic fighting, Shimat calmly speculated what Jin's true intentions might be.
'Reports said that summoning the BattleKings was a mistake. Furthermore, even with their addition, they won't fight us to the end with this power. They must have planned something...'
When Elona first entered the battle, Jin appeared indifferent even when the rift was attacked, just turning away.
To Shimat, even now, Jin didn’t seem particularly concerned with defending the rift.
He merely seemed to be trying to distract Shimat.
'...The only reason to divert my attention from the rift is to give someone, like Yona Runcandel, who specializes in stealth, an opportunity near the rift.'
Thinking this, Shimat noticed someone approaching the rift.
'Nameless King Owl, as expected.'
Upon seeing him, Shimat instantly concentrated all the energy of his divine sword to its tip.
Due to the sudden weakening of the Red energy waves, the balance of the members of the alliance who were moving within was disrupted. The concentrated energy fell like lightning above Owl’s head.
It was a swift and thin blade of energy, just like what he had shot at Elona during their first counterattack, aided by the power of the four aerial fortresses.
"Lord Owl!"
Jin was the first to react, rushing towards Owl.
The four Battle Kings also immediately tried to shield Owl, but they were too far away.
They couldn't move faster than Shimat's blade of energy.
In the end, only Jin and Owl had to counteract the energy, but Owl, seemingly not anticipating this situation, was slow to react.
"Cough!"
With a crash and the clanging sound -!
After colliding with Sigmund, the energy naturally dispersed, flying toward Owl behind him.
However, the energy blocked by Sigmund hadn't completely disappeared, leaving Jin unable to completely guard him.
Jin, too, spat out blood from the impact of the energy. When he quickly regained himself and looked back at Owl, holes were punctured all over his body.
'The heart and throat are okay...! But, why is it Lord Owl and not Lady Yona? And that expression...'
Owl was faintly smiling, visible only to Jin.
He had intentionally become bait.
Hoping that later, when Yona approaches the rift, Shimat would let his guard down even for a fraction.
Without hearing any explanations, Jin recognized Owl's plan.
He felt it was reckless and the risk did not seem to justify the potential reward.
Shimat was not the type to become complacent just because he had thwarted one strategy.
But Owl was confident.
Right at this moment, where even a second's mistake was not permissible, if he got hurt, it could very well work.
'Jin, I am still the Nameless King. In this world, there's no one better suited for such a strategy than me.'
The reason Owl threw himself into the fray was clear.
'Hmph, so Zipple is finally showing their face.'
Because they had confirmed that Zipple had entered the desert.
Naturally, Shimat would check Zipple’s position for a moment, and that would be the precise moment for Yona to move the device.
Yona was already hidden between the enemy lines, having completed her approach to Unit 2.
Her position was exactly opposite the direction where Zipple appeared.
Owl had precisely calculated all of this.
"Throw it well, muscle man."
"Of course, Miss Yona."
Hedo threw the device with all his might towards the rift.
The device zoomed past Shimat's back, like a blade.
At that moment, Shimat was startled and noticed the unfamiliar object flying towards the rift, but he couldn’t reach out with his sword.
Of course, Jin, whom they thought would stand his ground to protect Owl, had closed the distance and was swinging Sigmund.
'Lord Owl was right, now was the perfect time!'
Though Owl almost died once more when hit by a projectile from the ground, it was to propel Jin towards Shimat.
Owl launched Jin into the air, giving a thumbs-up before losing consciousness.
The liberation device was safely entering Lafrarosa passage.
